row.commencement_note: Keyed on FILING from 15.03.2020: an application filed before the window began gains nothing from it. The order is dated 10.01.2022 but excludes the window retrospectively. The checker applies it only when limitation was running during the window (SPEC D3); an acknowledgment made inside the window is sent to layer 2, not computed.
